caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent, green glass bottle with a cylindrical body and a short, narrow neck. The bottle features a slightly flared rim at the top and is positioned upright in the center of a plain, light beige background. There are subtle highlights and reflections on the surface of the bottle, indicating its glossy, glass material. The shading suggests a light source from the upper left, casting faint shadow details inside the lower part of the bottle. No other objects or elements are present in the composition. The artist's signature, "CHARLES GARJAN," is visible in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Shoe Blacking Bottle
